Puri's King Urges ISKCON to Halt Untimely Rath Yatras

The titular king of Puri, a sacred city in eastern India, has urged the International Society for Krishna Consciousness (ISKCON) to stop holding 'untimely' Rath Yatras. The Rath Yatra is a traditional festival celebrated by ISKCON followers, which involves the deity Lord Jagannath being taken out in a procession through the streets of Puri. The king's request comes amid concerns over safety and crowd management during the festival. The move has sparked debate among ISKCON followers and local authorities about the future of the Rath Yatra.
